 By Yoo Jee-ho
 SEOUL, Oct. 22 (Yonhap) -- World No. 3 Ryu Hae-ran put herself in early contention at the LPGA Tour event in her native South Korea on Thursday.
 Ryu shot a bogey-free round of five-under 67 to begin the BMW Ladies Championship at Pine Beach Golf Links in Haenam, some 330 kilometers south of Seoul. She is tied for third place with three other players and sits one stroke behind the two co-leaders, Karis Davidson of Australia and Yuri Yoshida of Japan.
 Ryu Hae-ran of South Korea tees off on the second hole during the first round of the BMW Ladies Championship on the LPGA Tour at Pine Beach Golf Links in Haenam, Jeonnam-Gwangju, on Oct. 22, 2026, in this photo provided by the tournament organizing committee. (PHOTO NOT FOR SALE) (Yonhap)
 Ryu collected three birdies on the front nine and two more on the back nine at the par-72 course that played 6,549 yards in the first round.
 Ryu, who won two majors earlier this season, is the highest-ranked player in the field this week.
 Kim Hyo-joo, sixth in the world rankings, is in a nine-way tie for eighth place at three-under 69. The group includes English star Lottie Woad, seventh in the world rankings, and South Korean veteran Amy Yang.
 Defending champion Kim Sei-young shot an even-par 72 to tie for 40th. She started her round with three consecutive bogeys but birdied the eighth, ninth and 17th.
 The field also includes 15 players from the Korea LPGA (KLPGA) Tour. Kim Min-sol, a rookie sensation who leads the domestic circuit in money this year, carded a two-under 70 to tie for 18th. The 20-year-old made five birdies against three bogeys.
 Seo Kyo-rim, a fellow 20-year-old who leads the KLPGA Tour in the Player of the Year points, put up a 72 with five birdies and five bogeys.
 Kim Hyo-joo of South Korea lines up a putt on the first green during the first round of the BMW Ladies Championship on the LPGA Tour at Pine Beach Golf Links in Haenam, Jeonnam-Gwangju, on Oct. 22, 2026, in this photo provided by the tournament organizing committee. (PHOTO NOT FOR SALE) (Yonhap)
